notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

Added 1 new card and 2 new artifacts.

Fixed 2 non-functional artifacts.

Fixed gameplay bugs reported via feedbacks.

Added battle phase speed setting to the options menu.

Thank you all for your reviews and feedbacks !

notes.title: Patch 1.01 – Performance Cap Fix
notes.content:
I’ve added a frame rate limit to prevent the game from running at unnecessarily high FPS on some systems. This should help reduce GPU usage and overheating issues.

Let me know if you experience any performance issues after this update!
